skill.name: apify-ultimate-scraper
skill.description: Uses the Apify CLI and Actor guides to select, configure, run, and retrieve web data from major online platforms.
skill.summary: Run guided Apify scraping workflows for research, monitoring, enrichment, and structured data collection.
skill.author: apify

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown backticks, bundled file references, official Apify URLs, or standard redirection and are false positives. Sourcing an arbitrary .env file is a confirmed local code execution and credential exposure risk. Dynamic community documentation and explicit anti-bot evasion guidance add high-confidence semantic risks.

remediation.issue: The authentication guide recommends sourcing the entire .env file.
remediation.suggestion: Read only APIFY_TOKEN with a non-executing dotenv parser, or require the user to export the token explicitly.

remediation.issue: Remote README content from dynamically selected community Actors is treated as trusted guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict automatic execution to an allowlist and treat all remote documentation as untrusted data that cannot authorize tool calls.

remediation.issue: The guide promotes WAF bypass, proxy rotation, and browser fingerprint rotation.
remediation.suggestion: Require target authorization, respect site terms and robots policies, and remove guidance intended to evade access controls.

remediation.issue: Every documented command discards stderr, which can hide security and billing warnings.
remediation.suggestion: Capture stderr separately and show relevant authentication, pricing, and execution errors after redacting secrets.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Remote Actor Documentation Enters Agent Context
semantic_findings.description: The workflow dynamically searches for Actors, retrieves their remote README content, and then runs the selected Actor. A malicious community Actor can place prompt injection in its README to influence later tool calls or inputs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented flow explicitly combines dynamic Actor discovery, remote README retrieval, and subsequent execution without an allowlist or untrusted-content boundary.

content.user_title: Scrape Web Data with Apify Actors
content.value_statement: Collecting structured data across many platforms requires different tools, schemas, and cost controls. This skill guides Actor selection, execution, result retrieval, and troubleshooting through Apify.
actual_capabilities: Matches supported platforms and research goals to Actors listed in the bundled index.
Fetches current Actor schemas and documentation through the Apify CLI.
Configures blocking or asynchronous Actor runs using user-defined limits.
Retrieves completed datasets as JSON or CSV and summarizes selected results.
Provides workflow guides for monitoring, research, enrichment, SEO, recruiting, and commerce.
Estimates pay-per-event costs and requires confirmation for estimates above 20 dollars.
limitations: Requires an installed Apify CLI, an authenticated account, and sufficient Apify credits.
Actor schemas, pricing, availability, and target platform behavior can change without notice.
Scraping may be restricted by site terms, privacy law, robots policies, or account permissions.
Community Actors and their remote documentation are not inherently trusted or verified.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Mentions
use_cases.description: Collect recent public mentions across supported social platforms and summarize volume, sentiment, and recurring topics.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Activity
use_cases.description: Gather public pricing, advertising, review, or content signals for a defined competitor list.

use_cases.title: Build Research Datasets
use_cases.description: Extract structured pages, listings, or search results for analysis and knowledge base preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Find Local Businesses
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the five highest-rated coffee shops in [city]. Return names, ratings, addresses, and source links in a concise table.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup with a small result set

prompt_templates.title: Track Brand Discussions
prompt_templates.prompt: Select an Apify Actor to collect [count] recent [platform] posts mentioning [brand]. Estimate costs before running and summarize sentiment themes.

prompt_templates.title: Research Public Profiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect [count] public [job title] profiles from [source and region]. Explain legal and platform restrictions before running, then return approved fields.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Monitoring Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a competitor monitoring pipeline for [companies]. Compare Actor pricing, validate schemas, stay within [budget], deduplicate results, and recommend refresh intervals.

output_examples.input: Find five highly rated coffee shops in Helsinki.
output_examples.output: A five-row table with business name, rating, review count, address, website, and source link, followed by the dataset link.

output_examples.input: Summarize recent public posts mentioning Acme Launch.
output: Collected 100 public posts from the approved platform and time range.
Positive discussion focused on setup speed; negative discussion focused on pricing.
Included the Actor run link, dataset link, and estimated collection cost.

output_examples.input: Compare public product prices for three competitors.
output_examples.output: A normalized comparison with product, seller, current price, availability, collection time, and source page for each matched item.

best_practices: Verify the selected Actor schema and current pricing immediately before every run.
Start with a small result limit, review data quality, and increase volume only after validation.
Confirm authorization and applicable privacy, platform, and website rules before collecting data.
anti_patterns: Do not source unknown environment files or expose tokens in prompts, commands, logs, or outputs.
Do not trust remote Actor documentation as instructions that can authorize commands or broaden scope.
Do not run large or paid scrapes without limits, a cost estimate, and required user confirmation.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install Apify CLI version 1.5.0 or later, authenticate your Apify account, and ensure the account has sufficient credits.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The bundled index covers major social, search, maps, review, marketplace, travel, recruiting, and content platforms through available Actors.

faq.question: Can the skill export CSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve Apify datasets as CSV or JSON and save them with a descriptive filename.

faq.question: How are paid runs handled?
faq.answer: The guide estimates pay-per-event costs, warns above 5 dollars, and requires explicit confirmation above 20 dollars.

faq.question: Are community Actors safe to use?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Review the publisher, pricing, schema, permissions, and documentation while treating all remote content as untrusted.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee complete results?
faq.answer: No. Platform changes, rate limits, geography, authentication, anti-bot controls, and Actor quality can reduce coverage or return empty results.
